product: Real-time official sports data, technology and broadcast/advertising platform, split into Betting Technology, Content and Services and Media Technology, Content and Services (Moment Engine, GeniusIQ). Launched Prediction.com, a prediction-market comparison platform, on Sep 17 2026; Legend added Covers.com, Casino.org and Casino Guru.
demand: Strong. Q2 2026 group revenue rose 64.7 percent to $195.5M and adjusted EBITDA 54 percent to $52.6M, beating guidance, and management raised the FY2026 outlook. Media plus new prediction-markets demand are the incremental drivers alongside a resilient core betting business.
pricing_power: Reasonably strong. Betting growth is explicitly attributed to price increases on contract renewals and renegotiations plus expanded value-add services (Q2 2026 release). Exclusive official league data rights underpin this, but pricing power depends on renewing those rights against competing bidders.
competition: Sources read do not name a peer set. Genius positions itself as the only company combining official sports data with media and advertising (May 1 2026 Legend release), implying rivals in official sports data or sports advertising technology are the competition. No verified competitor share data was found.
team: Founder and CEO Mark Locke; CFO Bryan Castellani; Chief Revenue Officer Josh Linforth; Chief Product and Technology Officer Matt Fleckenstein; President North America Steve Bornstein; Chief Marketing Officer Tony Marlow (appointed Apr 9 2026); Chief Legal Officer Thomas Russell. NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell appeared at the Investor Day.
market_strategy: Convert exclusive official league data into scaled media and advertising: GeniusIQ and Moment Engine for real-time activation, Legend owned digital properties for iGaming audiences, and prediction markets via Polymarket, Kalshi and Prediction.com, targeting the 2028 outlook set at the December 3 2025 Investor Day.
bull: Q2 2026 revenue rose 64.7% to $195.5M with adjusted EBITDA up 54% to $52.6M; FY26 guidance raised to $1.005-1.025B and $285-295M EBITDA; six dated raises in 90 days (Guggenheim, Macquarie, Oppenheimer, Needham, BTIG) after the Aug 6 beat.
bear: Q2 net loss widened 42% to $76.7M, H1 operating cash outflow $147.2M against $155M cash and $785M debt; $1.53B goodwill plus $202.5M contingent consideration at impairment risk; Zacks cut to Strong Sell Aug 10; CLO sold 50,000 shares at $6.5113 and shares fell 5.23% Sep 24.
falsifier: FY2026 revenue reported below $1.005B or adjusted EBITDA below $285M, or year-end cash under $260M, when results are released (guidance reaffirmed or cut at the Dec 8, 2026 AGM).
web_what_changed: Last 90 days: LIGA MX/Polymarket data deal (Jun 10); Polymarket partnership expanded (Aug 4) and Kalshi deal (Aug 5); Q2 2026 beat with FY26 guidance raised to $1.005-1.025B revenue and $285-295M adjusted EBITDA (Aug 6); Prediction.com launched (Sep 17); 2026 AGM scheduled for Dec 8 (Sep 23). Chief Legal Officer sold 50,000 shares at $6.5113 (Form 4).
web_not_known_yesterday: No company filing or release dated Sep 24-25 was found. Latest company disclosure was Sep 23: 2026 AGM set for Dec 8, 2026. Shares closed $5.80, down 5.23 percent, on Sep 24; coverage linked the weakness to the Sep 17-18 insider sale of 50,000 shares at $6.5113 by Chief Legal Officer Thomas Russell.
web_demand_price_volume_mix: Price and mix, plus acquisition volume. Betting revenue rose 27.5 percent to $117.4M, driven by price increases on contract renewals and renegotiations, expanded value-add services, market expansion and new offerings (primary). Media revenue rose 193 percent mainly from Legend plus Moment Engine and GeniusIQ demand. Volume is not broken out.
web_suppliers: Official data and media rights from leagues and teams: NFL, English Premier League, NCAA, Liga MX, Swiss Football League, CBF, Pac-12 (primary). These rights holders hold pricing power and are the main constraint; renewal and rights-cost inflation are flagged risks in the 2025 Form 20-F. Technology and cloud inputs are not named in sources read.
web_customers: Sportsbooks, broadcasters and brands: DraftKings, FanDuel, bet365, CBS, NBC, ESPN, Coca-Cola, Diageo; over 1,000 sports organizations (primary). Customer concentration is not disclosed in the documents read; the Form 20-F flags reliance on relationships with sports organizations and renewal risk.
web_who_loses: Rivals that supply only official data or only sports media and advertising lose share, since Genius claims to be the only company operating both official data and media/advertising businesses (Legend close release, May 1 2026). Traditional media intermediaries and non-official data providers are disintermediated as league and brand budgets shift to official-data ad products.
web_contradicting_evidence: Q2 2026 net loss widened 42 percent to $76.7M and H1 net loss was $132.2M; H1 operating cash outflow was $147.2M. Total debt is about $785M against $155M cash, plus $202.5M contingent consideration and $1.53B goodwill and intangibles. Shares fell 5.23 percent to $5.80 on Sep 24 and insiders sold; Zacks downgraded to Strong Sell (Aug 10).
web_if_management_right: FY2026 revenue reaches $1.005-1.025B (about 52 percent growth) and adjusted EBITDA $285-295M (about 28.6 percent margin), with year-end cash about $260M implying over $100M H2 cash flow. Prediction markets (Polymarket, Kalshi, Prediction.com) and Legend media scale compound toward the 2028 targets given at the December 2025 Investor Day.
web_if_management_wrong: Legend integration or advertising demand disappoints while league rights costs rise at renewals. Cash keeps burning (H1 operating outflow $147.2M) against only $155M cash and $785M debt, pressuring liquidity. Goodwill and intangibles of $1.53B and $202.5M contingent consideration would face impairment, and non-GAAP EBITDA still excludes heavy stock-based compensation.
web_second_order_beneficiaries: Prediction markets Kalshi and Polymarket; sportsbooks DraftKings, FanDuel and bet365; leagues and teams (NFL, EPL, Liga MX) monetising data; broadcasters and publishers TelevisaUnivision, StackAdapt, Equativ and Magnite; advertisers and brands; and Legend owned properties Covers.com, Casino.org and Casino Guru.
